title: application_window
description: The open-to-close window for a grant application cycle. The FY 2027 State Water Infrastructure Grant application cycle closes at 11:59 p.m. on September 15, 2026 Central Time. Timezone must be stored explicitly; the source-native timezone is America/Chicago.

opens_at.description: Application window open time with UTC offset or Z suffix. Null if source does not state an open time.

closes_at.description: Application window close time. Must include timezone offset. For FY2027 the source-stated deadline is 2026-09-15T23:59:00 Central Time.

source_timezone.description: IANA timezone name as stated by or inferred from the official source, e.g. America/Chicago.
